name: No Shortcuts
about: Scrum Master 3's LIVE No Shortcuts, on demand: three checks. The owner's rule of a job changed; a LIVE result edited by hand (its row in the office database not what its own RUN delivered); a pinned speed check changed. Red on any, each with your one step.

speed_pins.what: the SPEED rows of the smoke test: each rule, its plant, THE BENCHMARK and its phases
THE SPEED BAR: every screen's numbers, the noise allowed, frost_most; it only moves down
the timer of the speed rows: the pages measured, the records grown, the rounds

facts.accept_step: look at it, then accept: write a new value in this agent's facts accepted_at (agent.json, e.g. the date and time now), place the agent again, then press RUN on No Shortcuts: every rule is taken as it is now
facts.result_step: a result was written by a hand, not its RUN: press RUN on {name} (its RUN writes its row again)
facts.pin_step: write your speed pins in this agent's facts speed_pins (agent.json: each its path and sha256, from shasum -a 256 <file>), then place the agent again
facts.repin: · or, only if you moved the bar yourself: your own re-pin, its new sha256 (shasum -a 256 <file>) in this agent's facts speed_pins (never done by this program)

card.pitch: The owner's rules, the results and the speed checks are never changed by a tool or a hand
